name: Capoeira basics
detail: Ginga, esquiva and the low game. Needs room to move.

drills.name: Ginga
drills.purpose: The step everything else in capoeira comes out of.
cues: Stay low — knees soft the whole time
Cross the arm that matches the back foot
Keep breathing; this is a rhythm, not a hold

drills.name: Esquiva
drills.purpose: Getting out of the way low, so you finish able to move.
cues: Weight onto the bent leg, chest over the knee
One hand to the floor, eyes up
Come back to the ginga rather than standing straight up
